data.name: Wexed
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to WEXED, a chaotic multiplayer game where wizards clash in a vibrant magical forest. Your objective is simple: steal the unique Soul Bottles from every other player and secure them in your own Mushroom base to win. But beware, the path to victory is paved with shifting alliances and inevitable betrayals.

Core Gameplay:

  • Steal & Protect: Every wizard starts with one precious Soul Bottle at their personal Mushroom base. To win, you must collect all bottles from your rivals and bring them back to your base. Protecting your own bottle is paramount, as losing it means you're out of the game.

  • Chaotic Combat: Engage in frantic battles using a variety of silly spells, weird weapons, and funny powers. Expect confetti explosions, rubber chicken projectiles, and other absurd magical effects. Combat is designed to be fast-paced and unpredictable, rewarding quick thinking and mischievous tactics.

  • Strategic Alliances & Betrayal: Proximity voice chat allows you to communicate with nearby players. Form temporary alliances to take down powerful monsters for valuable rewards, or to overwhelm a strong opponent. However, remember that trust is a fragile commodity; every alliance is an opportunity for a perfectly timed betrayal to steal their bottles.

  • The Trader: Discover the Trader, a neutral safe zone where you can spend your hard-earned monster loot. Upgrade your spells, acquire new weapons, and enhance your wizard's abilities. But be quick – while you're shopping, your rivals are growing stronger and plotting their next move.

  • Dynamic Forest: The magical forest is alive with monsters that drop rewards, and environmental hazards that can be used to your advantage. Adapt your strategy to the ever-changing battlefield.

Every match in WEXED is a unique story of cunning, chaos, and unexpected turns. Will you be the master of deception, or will you fall victim to a friend's betrayal?

Wishlist WEXED now and prepare for the ultimate Chaotic Wizard Heist!
